newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Aug renovation funds rise 17.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Aug renovation funds rise 17.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's investment in renovation and restructuring of enterprises and factories was 143.1 billion yuan ($17.2 billion) in January-August, a rise of 17.4 percent over the year-ago period, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.
Growth in investment in renovation during the period had outstripped growth in investment in capital construction by 2.6 percentage points, the news agency said.
It was the first time renovation growth had exceeded capital construction growth, it said but gave no further details.
China has said annual growth in capital construction should not fall below 19 percent and that growth for investment in renovation and restructuring should be at least 20.4 percent.
